newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK short interbank rates firm on month-end demand.
newsitem.headline: HK short interbank rates firm on month-end demand.

text.p: Hong Kong interbank market rates were little changed on Tuesday although shorter term rates rose a shade due to month-end demand, dealers said.
Overnight cash ended at 5-5/16 1/4 percent against 5-1/4 1/8 percent at Monday midday while three month money finished at 5-1/2 7/16 percent versus 5-1/2 3/8 percent.
"The longer term is not really changed, but for the short term, it's quite tight because of month-end demand," a dealer with an American bank said.
Market participants were also expecting rates to edge up with several companies making new share offers, he said.
